2608.03961.title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
2608.03961.paper_summary: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model confidence, to a per-query sampling budget. The controller assigns fewer samples to easier or more confident prompts and more samples to harder or less certain prompts, making inference-time compute inspectable rather than fixed or opaque. We evaluate under a fair-alignment protocol with matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection, and compare against best-of-$N$, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty-based baselines on question-answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across models and datasets, adaptive fuzzy control improves over several standard baselines and remains close to a selector-matched full-budget control while reducing the average number of samples. These findings suggest that interpretable adaptive sampling is a practical direction for more efficient test-time reasoning in large language models.
2608.03961.paper_summary_zh: 測試時間的縮放透過生成和聚合多個候選答案來改善大型語言模型的推理，然而許多流程使用固定的每查詢預算，對於簡單和困難的提示消耗相同的計算資源。這些固定預算也難以檢查，因為它們無法解釋為什麼特定的提示會獲得特定數量的樣本。我們提出了一種自適應測試時間縮放，使用輕量級的模糊控制器，將可解釋的信號（包括估計的提示複雜度和模型信心）映射到每查詢的取樣預算。該控制器對於較簡單或信心較高的提示分配較少的樣本，對於較困難或不確定的提示分配較多的樣本，使推理時間的計算可檢查，而不是固定或不透明。我們在公平對齊的協議下進行評估，匹配解碼設置和控制答案選擇，並與最佳的$N$、計算感知縮放和基於自信的基準進行比較，針對問題回答和數學推理任務。在各模型和數據集上，自適應模糊控制在多個標準基準上有所改善，並且在減少平均樣本數的同時仍然接近選擇器匹配的全預算控制。這些發現表明，可解釋的自適應取樣是大型語言模型中更高效的測試時間推理的一個實用方向。
2608.03961.author: Mobina Kashaniyan et.al.
